minutes.headline: PACC heard a developer's pitch for a new standalone studio building, approved a FY23 budget and warrant, and bought a used truss.
minutes.summary: Developers and an architect presented a concept for a new 2,500 sq ft standalone building next to the police/public safety building as a home for PACC. The committee then approved minutes, the FY23 warrant article, the FY23 budget as proposed, and a used lighting truss. It voted to pursue the studio-space matter and discussed how to schedule around the municipal building design committee meeting.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to accept the FY23 budget as proposed and authorized a presentation of it to the finance committee.
The committee unanimously accepted the FY23 warrant article covering the PEG access enterprise and capital budgets.
Developers and an architect presented a concept for a new standalone studio building beside the public safety building, with no budget numbers given.
The committee approved the purchase of a used truss system from a vendor, capped by the motion at a set maximum.
A motion to pursue the studio space matter was made, but the vote was not audible; the matter goes on next month's agenda.

why_it_matters: The FY23 budget and warrant article are the cable access spending plan that goes to the finance committee and then to town meeting, so the next votes touch how cable-fee revenue is used.
A possible new studio building would be a large, unpriced capital question for the town, and no cost has been put on the record yet.
